verdict.rationale: Oneleet's Fieldwork page says its AI agents collect, validate, and package control evidence on a user-defined schedule, which is close to autonomous background automation. Service keys, which are decoupled from user accounts, support headless AI-agent and script automation. The integrations also provide ongoing background monitoring of AWS and GitHub. However, the scheduling claim is a single marketing statement, and custom automations otherwise depend on external scripts or agents calling in via service keys or MCP. Missing for 10: documented automation builder or workflow configuration (triggers, schedules, actions), detail on how Fieldwork schedules are set up, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
